gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mozilla-headline: Chunky, ancient, a little stubborn. Mozilla Headline answers Nordic's tight, closed letters with big-bodied lowercase and a splayed c terminal, so the heading feels carved and the text feels friendly.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-mozilla-text: Nordic has stems like dowels and arcs like bent dowels, giving it a blunt, ancient presence. And Mozilla Text brings tall, bold-looking lowercase with flared terminals, a more modern voice that sits beside it without competing.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-nata-sans: Nordic spaces its letters like brush dabs placed far apart, with cramped, closed openings that feel pressed into the page. And Nata Sans meets that with a large central band and wide, unclosed curves, drawn with a technical-pen steadiness.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-nobile: Nordic is all closed, cramped shapes in a single stroke weight. Nobile follows with open letter mouths like unjoined chalk arcs and barely any gap between x-height and caps, so the page moves from tight to unguarded.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-nokora: Nokora reads thick and dark, with an s that never tightens. Nordic above it has the weight of a drawn wire, so the heading looks wiry and ancient while the text lays down a heavy, friendly stripe.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-kufi-arabic: Powerful is the first word that fits Nordic, whose counters are framed by strokes of matching width. Noto Kufi Arabic then opens a welcoming gap in the c and keeps capitals only slightly above lowercase, a modern, easy-going answer to those closed shapes.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans: Noto Sans reads wide and friendly, its lowercase filling most of the letter height. Nordic has no thick-thin shift in its curves, and if that heading shrinks too far its cramped openings will start to clog beside the open text.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-adlam: Noto Sans Adlam reads full and tall, with curve endings kept well apart and a lowercase c, s and z that fill their space. Nordic, with no calligraphic swell, stays dense.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-adlam-unj: Nordic's spacing feels like brush dabs placed far apart, each letter pressed shut like a folded leaf. But Noto Sans Adlam Unjoined gives generous room between curve ends and stems, with little height difference between cases, so the two feel like old stone beside fresh paper.
gen-dafont-nordic-gf-noto-sans-anatolian: Heavy, ancient, pressed shut, that is Nordic in a glance, with a single stroke weight and cramped openings. Noto Sans Anatolian Hieroglyphs lets terminals point outward under it, an open and modern sans.
